kinds.d: App for writing, organising and searching personal notes.
App for listing tasks, tracking their progress and planning personal or small-team projects.
App for keeping a calendar and scheduling appointments.
Program for laying out ideas as branching maps around a central topic.
Program for drawing flowcharts, org charts and network or floor diagrams from connected shapes.
Program or hosted tool giving a shared infinite canvas for sticky notes, sketches and workshops.

notes: Restraint-only. Note-taking 43->12 (dropped discontinued and minor tools; Ulysses is a writing app, IPython Notebook a developer tool; Microsoft Office range dropped). Task manager 134->12 personal and small-team apps; dropped enterprise project-portfolio, ERP, issue-tracker and server tools per brief (Jira, Microsoft Project/Project Server, Primavera P6, RiskyProject, Planisware, Workfront, Redmine, MantisBT, SAP, NetSuite etc.), Google Keep (note app) and minor tails. Calendar 29->10 (dropped discontinued Sunbird, Sunrise, Chandler, Now Up-to-Date, Meeting Maker, Ecco Pro, business booking tools). Mind mapping 17->9. Diagramming 27->12; Miro, Excalidraw and Whimsical moved from the old diagramming list into Online whiteboard, which had no models. No new kinds.
